title: Dataset : Contextual influences on risk-taking in children and adults
question: How does task context change risk-taking across age groups and experiment variants?
publisher: Lacombe, Pénélope (Institute of Biology, University of Neuchatel, Neuchatel, Switzerland)
variables_and_units: age, context, trial and risk-taking responses
validation_design: participant and experiment variant Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Complete source CSV for four experimental variants; retain supplied participant and condition encodings.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Hold out participants and variants. Age associations are not causal effects; participant counts must come from source IDs, not row counts.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
